name: b_chain
about: Branch B's chain, frozen 15 Nov about 13:00 by card 398 (session 2026-11-15-lineSprB-10) on the orchestrating session's answer of 15 Nov 12:48: round 12's rules (drafts/r12.json, changes 1 to 3 of fable_answer_3.md on round 9, written down before scoring), Jev lines fixed t = 0.3 and u = 0.65 (not fitted). It replaces round 9 because, on the repaired cited texts (repaired_texts.md), the wrongly-passed limit is Sonnet alone's own count on the same texts (14 of 75, was 12 on the old texts), and round 12 then meets all three limits: 3 of 75 right pieces wrongly rejected (round 9: 6), 14 of 75 wrong pieces wrongly passed (round 9: 14), 23 of 150 undecided (round 9: 20). Round 12's own description: Round 12: changes 1, 2 and 3 of fable_answer_3.md on round 9 with the Jev line fixed at 0.3 (not fitted), written down before scoring (15 Nov 11:50). Change 1: every rejection of round 9 is final unless Opus answered supported (Opus unsure or no Opus answer does not block). Change 2: when Sonnet says not supported and round 9's Sonnet rule did not fire, the piece is rejected if Opus says not supported and Gemma or Haiku also does. Change 3: when Sonnet says unsure, the piece is rejected if Opus says not supported and neither Gemma nor Haiku said supported. Opus = shared neutral_v1.md, piece_only, the same question as card 400's held-back answers. Used only if it meets all three limits (4 or fewer of 75 wrongly rejected, 30 or fewer of 150 undecided, 12 or fewer of 75 wrongly passed); no partial mixes otherwise.
